_description: Sprint 10b (ADR-0033), plan §E.1 item 3 / §E.9 item 3. CONSTRUCTED — per §0/§A.1, there is no real situational phrasing on staging to draw from; real staging traffic is entirely self-authored canonical test questions (D6's pre-pilot rationale). Each pair: a canonical form (already in corpus vocabulary — several are real gold questions from sprint-2c/10a) + a constructed situational/colloquial variant of the SAME underlying question. One canonical-only control with no situational twin, to prove the no-op requirement on a question decomposition should never touch.
_status: CP-4 (build authorization): constructed set only — presented for Pedram's realism check BEFORE the eval harness is built or run. No driver script exists yet; do not run this set until CP-4 is cleared.
_metrics_per_spec_4_2: Retrieval hit-rate delta on situational forms: does adding decomposed_queries recover the same top chunk the canonical form gets, that the situational form alone misses?

Zero change on canonical forms: decomposed_queries empty, OR non-empty but changing no citations — assert on the retrieval union's CHUNK-ID SET, not just the final answer text (T-superset, build authorization) — the answer could coincidentally match while the evidence set differs.
Watch-for failure mode: a decomposition that adds noise which changes the citations WITHOUT changing the answer's substance.

canonical_only_control.question: ¿cuántos días de asuntos propios tengo?
canonical_only_control.label: semi-colloquial control (citation-neutrality)
canonical_only_control.note: Pedram's review decision (§3.5, this sprint): the acceptance bar is citation-neutrality, not decomposed_queries emptiness. This question routes non-empty on every real run observed (hr-ai proposes 1-2 rephrasings every time, e.g. 'permisos por asuntos propios o permisos retribuidos') — that non-empty decomposition is EXPECTED for this phrasing and is not itself a finding. What must hold is that its final citation set (chunk-ids AND documents) does not move between decomposition-suppressed and decomposition-applied runs. Kept in the set specifically because it is a good semi-colloquial stress case (short, everyday phrasing of a real permiso type), not because it is linguistically canonical.

canonical_only_control.question: ¿Cuántos días de permiso por matrimonio?
canonical_only_control.label: truly canonical control (citation-neutrality)
canonical_only_control.note: Added per Pedram's review decision (§3.5): a second control drawn verbatim from 'the real 39' — the 39 distinct real/test question strings pulled from staging chat_messages (plan.md §A.1) — chosen because it is already in exact corpus/legal register (no situational framing, no colloquialism) and has a known-good real answer (art. 37 ET, 'quince días naturales', sprint-10a gold id 10). Same citation-neutrality bar as c1: decomposed_queries may fire, but the final citation set must not move.
